stories.title: 作為一家規模龐大的搜尋引擎，ChatGPT 現在面臨歐盟更嚴格的監管。 / ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine

sources.title: 作為一家規模龐大的搜尋引擎，ChatGPT 現在面臨歐盟更嚴格的監管。 / ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine
sources.title_zh: 作為一家規模龐大的搜尋引擎，ChatGPT 現在面臨歐盟更嚴格的監管。
sources.title_en: ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine
sources.title_original: ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine
sources.summary: The EU Commission is classifying ChatGPT as a very large search engine under the Digital Services Act for the first time, with at least 45 million monthly EU users. By the end of 2026, OpenAI has to deliver risk assessments, transparency reports, and an ad archive, among other things. Whether the Commission can also demand access to training data is disputed among legal experts. The article ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 歐盟委員會首次依據《數位服務法》將ChatGPT歸類為超大型搜尋引擎，其歐盟月活躍用戶至少達4,500萬。 2026年底，OpenAI必須提交風險評估報告、透明度報告和廣告存檔等資料。歐盟委員會是否也有權要求其提供培訓數據，目前法律專家對此存在爭議。本文《ChatGPT作為超大型搜尋引擎，如今面臨更嚴格的歐盟監管》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

stories.title: OpenAI 僅在其人工智慧真正發揮作用時才開始向部分客戶收費 / OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works

sources.title: OpenAI 僅在其人工智慧真正發揮作用時才開始向部分客戶收費 / OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 僅在其人工智慧真正發揮作用時才開始向部分客戶收費
sources.title_en: OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works
sources.title_original: OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works
sources.summary: OpenAI is offering some large customers outcome-based pricing, where they pay only once the AI actually finishes a task. Salesforce, Adobe, and several startups are also moving away from fixed subscription fees. The central dispute stays the same. Who gets credit for the success, the software or the customer? The article OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 為部分大型客戶提供以結果為基礎的定價模式，即只有在人工智慧實際完成任務後才需付費。 Salesforce、Adobe 和多家新創公司也正在逐步取消固定訂閱費用。核心爭議依然存在：成功的功勞究竟歸於軟體還是客戶？本文《OpenAI 開始僅在人工智慧實際運作後才向部分客戶收費》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.summary: China's top memory maker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) is producing HBM3E for the first time in small quantities, a fast memory found in many current AI processors. The article China's CXMT makes its first HBM3E chips, closing the AI memory gap appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.summary: Instagram is replacing its "AI creator" tag with a new "AI-generated profile" label because users can't tell AI profiles from real people. sources.title_en: OpenAI and rival AI labs are buying tens of thousands of Mac minis to train computer-use agents
sources.title_original: OpenAI and rival AI labs are buying tens of thousands of Mac minis to train computer-use agents
sources.summary: According to The Information, OpenAI has purchased tens of thousands of Mac minis and Mac Studios to train computer agents. Anthropic also relies on Apple hardware. Demand is so high that the most powerful models have been sold out for months. Apple’s Mac revenue rose by nearly 29 percent to $10.4 billion in the June quarter. The article OpenAI and rival AI labs are buying tens of thousands of Mac minis to train computer-use agents appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據The Information通報，OpenAI已購買數萬臺Mac mini和Mac Studio用於訓練電腦智慧體。 Anthropic也依賴蘋果的硬體。由於需求旺盛，效能最強的機型已售罄數月。 蘋果的的Mac產品在6月季度的營收成長了近29%，達到104億美元。文章《OpenAI及其競爭對手的AI實驗室正在採購數萬臺Mac mini以訓練電腦智慧體》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.title: OpenClaw 2.0 帶來了簡化的設定、重新設計的瀏覽器應用程式以及多人遊戲模式。 / OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions
sources.title_zh: OpenClaw 2.0 帶來了簡化的設定、重新設計的瀏覽器應用程式以及多人遊戲模式。
sources.title_en: OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions
sources.title_original: OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions
sources.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released version 2.0 of its open-source AI platform, its largest release to date with over 16,000 pull requests. New features include cloud sessions on rented machines, real-time collaboration, and a browser app rebuilt from scratch. The software now automatically detects existing resources like API keys and AI subscriptions during setup. The article OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenClaw 基金會發布了其開源 AI 平臺 2.0 版本，這是迄今為止最大的版本更新，包含了超過 16,000 個 pull request。新功能包括在租用機器上進行雲端會話、即時協作以及完全重構的瀏覽器應用程式。該軟體現在可以在設定過程中自動偵測現有資源，例如 API 金鑰和 AI 訂閱。文章《OpenClaw 2.0 帶來簡化的設定、重構的瀏覽器應用程式和多人會話》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title: OpenAI計畫11月終止向Cursor直接提供AI模型
sources.title_zh: OpenAI計畫11月終止向Cursor直接提供AI模型
sources.title_original: OpenAI計畫11月終止向Cursor直接提供AI模型
sources.summary: OpenAI週末宣佈計畫在今年11月12日終止直接向AI輔助程式開發工具Cursor提供OpenAI模型的合約，可能和SpaceX收購Cursor有關。 OpenAI計畫結束對Cursor提供AI模型的合約，他們已對Cursor說明2026年11月12日之前為過渡期。在過渡期間，該公司仍然會提供Cursor存取現今正在使用的模型，但對方也可以選擇提早結束存取。OpenAI會在雙方確認後公佈合約終止日期。

That's because ChatGPT is now considered a Very Large Online Search Engine under the EU's Digital Services Act, a set of laws regulating major online services and […]

sources.summary: Instagram is finally taking steps to address the rise of fake AI-influencer accounts that have gotten harder to spot. It's also renaming the "AI creator" label to "AI-generated profile" to make it clear when a profile features an AI-generated person that's not a real human being. "We've heard that people don't like seeing a profile […]
sources.summary_zh: Instagram 終於開始採取措施應對日益猖獗的虛假 AI 網紅帳號，這些帳號越來越難以辨識。 Instagram 也將“AI 建立者”標籤更名為“AI 生成的個人資料”，以便明確區分哪些個人資料中的人物是由 AI 生成的，而非真人。 “我們瞭解到使用者不喜歡看到這樣的個人資料…”

sources.summary: 回顧2026年7月全球資安威脅發展趨勢，資安廠商Check Point對生成式AI資安風險提出警示，以全球地區來看，拉丁美洲與北美的風險暴露程度最高，歐洲與亞太地區略低於全球平均；而在產業方面，商業服務業、健康與醫療業的風險暴露程度最高，其次是資訊科技業與政府。

sources.summary: Anthropic研究團隊公開AI安全研究評測基準TASTE（The AI Safety Taste Evaluation），以研究提案比較評估AI模型的研究判斷能力。結果顯示，表現最佳的Fable 5與基準答案一致率只有60%，低於有經驗研究者的77%，多數受測模型在統計上仍難與隨機猜測明確區分。

sources.title_zh: 本地AI工具LM Studio Bionic新增Shell指令自動審查，先程式分析再交AI代理判斷
sources.title_original: 本地AI工具LM Studio Bionic新增Shell指令自動審查，先程式分析再交AI代理判斷
sources.summary: 本地AI模型工具LM Studio推出的AI代理應用Bionic，新增Shell指令自動審查功能Auto Review。Bionic可使用本地或雲端的開放模型處理程式開發、文件等工作，當AI代理準備執行Shell指令時，Auto Review會先以程式分析辨識可安全執行的操作，無法完整判斷時才交由獨立的審查代理處理，減少使用者逐一確認指令的情況。

sources.title_original: OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway
sources.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released v2026.8.1, which the project calls OpenClaw 2.0: 933 contributors, 569 first-timers, and more than 16,000 pull requests, roughly half of every PR ever merged into the repo. Setup now reuses existing subscriptions, API keys and local models. The rebuilt Control UI cut test-harness startup from about 1.6 seconds to 575 ms. Shared cloud sessions add real multiplayer, though the docs are explicit that they are not a security boundary. The post OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: OpenClaw 基金會發布了 v2026.8.1 版本，專案稱為 OpenClaw 2.0：總共有 933 位貢獻者，其中 569 位是首次參與，並且收到了超過 16,000 個拉取請求，約佔所有合併到程式碼庫中的拉取請求總數的一半。新版本在設定過程中可以重複使用現有的訂閱、API 金鑰和本機模型。重新建構的控制介面將測試框架的啟動時間從約 1.6 秒縮短至 575 毫秒。共享雲端會話增加了真正的多人遊戲功能，但文件明確指出它們並非安全邊界。這篇文章《OpenClaw 發布 OpenClaw 2.0：引導式模型設定、575 毫秒控制介面啟動以及每個網關一個信任邊界》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

stories.title: 語音和即時代理的最低延遲推理 API：首次令牌到達時間 (TTFT) 基準測試 / Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark

sources.title: 語音和即時代理的最低延遲推理 API：首次令牌到達時間 (TTFT) 基準測試 / Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark
sources.title_zh: 語音和即時代理的最低延遲推理 API：首次令牌到達時間 (TTFT) 基準測試
sources.title_en: Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark
sources.title_original: Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark
sources.summary: Voice agents fail on latency long before they fail on intelligence. Time to first token is the metric most teams use to choose an inference API, and it is the right starting point and the wrong stopping point. This benchmark works through every layer of the voice stack — LLM, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and speech-to-speech — using figures verified against primary sources on August 30, 2026, with each number labeled as independently measured, vendor-published, or vendor-measured on its own product. The post Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 語音代理的延遲問題遠早於其智慧水準的問題。首次令牌處理時間 (TTFT) 是大多數團隊選擇推理 API 時使用的指標，它雖然是正確的起點，但卻是錯誤的終點。此基準測試涵蓋了語音協定堆疊的每一層——LLM、語音轉文字、文字轉語音和語音轉語音——並使用截至 2026 年 8 月 30 日經原始資料來源驗證的數據，每個數據都標註為獨立測量、廠商發布或廠商在其自身產品上測量。本文《語音和即時代理的最低延遲推理 API：首次令牌處理時間 (TTFT) 基準測試》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

primary_item.summary_zh: 在Glassdoor上，理賠員提及人工智慧的評論中，高達98%都是負面的。 “人工智慧只是一種工具，”一位用戶告訴《連線》雜誌，“絕不應該賦予它控制權。”

stories.title: AI生成詐騙內容成新威脅，數發部與Meta、Google等四大平臺聯手建立AI源頭阻詐防線

sources.title: AI生成詐騙內容成新威脅，數發部與Meta、Google等四大平臺聯手建立AI源頭阻詐防線
sources.title_zh: AI生成詐騙內容成新威脅，數發部與Meta、Google等四大平臺聯手建立AI源頭阻詐防線
sources.title_original: AI生成詐騙內容成新威脅，數發部與Meta、Google等四大平臺聯手建立AI源頭阻詐防線
sources.summary: 隨著生成式AI普及，詐騙集團可大量生成詐騙文案、快速建立假帳號，甚至利用AI製作更具可信度的內容，使網路平臺成為詐騙資訊擴散的重要管道。數發部今天(8/31)宣佈將深化和四大平臺業者合作，定期與平臺業者研商與情資交換機制，由政府提供最新詐騙樣態，協助平臺將其轉化為AI模型訓練資料及偵測規則，提升主動辨識能力，讓防詐機制從事後下架轉向事前預防。 「詐欺犯罪危害防制條例」在2024年三讀透過，2025年底立法院三讀透過其修正草案，四大網路廣告平臺依法須建立詐欺風險評估、防制計畫、廣告主實名制及廣告資訊揭露制度，並配合主動或依政府通知下架涉詐廣告，以提升廣告透明度並避免冒用他人身分投放廣告。

stories.title: 瞭解 ChatGPT 工作 / Understanding ChatGPT Work

sources.title: 瞭解 ChatGPT 工作 / Understanding ChatGPT Work
sources.title_zh: 瞭解 ChatGPT 工作
sources.title_en: Understanding ChatGPT Work
sources.title_original: Understanding ChatGPT Work
sources.summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so far. ChatGPT Work is actually two products The more interesting version of ChatGPT Work is the one that runs in the cloud. This can be accessed via chatgpt.com or through the ChatGPT mobile apps. Let's call it Work Cloud . If you install the ChatGPT desktop app - the app that used to be called Codex - you gain access to a thing called ChatGPT Work that can access files and run programs directly on your computer. Let's call that one Work Local . This one feels more like regular Codex re-skinned to be less intimidating to non-software-developers. ( Update : Work Cloud is also available from the ChatGPT desktop app, via a Where should this chat run? dropdown.) For the rest of this article I'm going to talk exclusively about Work Cloud. Work is for paid subscribers only Right now, ChatGPT Work (in both flavors) is available only to $20/month and up subscribers. Free users and $8/month Go users do not have access. Work has features that aren't available in Chat The interface for accessing Work is a tab selector, which presents it as an alternative to Chat: The obvious question is when should I use Chat, and when should I use Work? OpenAI's official answer to that question is: Use Chat when you want an answer, explanation, brainstorm, or short draft. sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 7 月 9 日發布了 ChatGPT Work，此後一直在對其進行快速迭代。這是一款極其複雜但功能強大的產品。以下是我目前對它的一些瞭解。 ChatGPT Work 實際上包含兩個產品。 ChatGPT Work 中更有趣的版本是雲端版本。可以透過 chatgpt.com 或 ChatGPT 行動應用程式存取。我們稱之為 Work Cloud。如果您安裝了 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式（以前稱為 Codex），則可以存取名為 ChatGPT Work 的產品，它可以直接存取電腦上的檔案並執行程式。我們稱之為 Work Local。這款產品感覺更像是重新包裝的 Codex，旨在讓非軟體開發人員更容易上手。 （更新：Work Cloud 也可透過 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式訪問，方法是點選「此聊天應在哪裡執行？」下拉式選單。）本文餘下部分將專門討論 Work Cloud。 Work 目前僅供付費使用者使用。 ChatGPT Work（兩種版本）目前僅對每月 20 美元及以上的訂閱使用者開放。免費使用者和每月 8 美元的 Go 使用者無法存取。 Work 擁有 Chat 所不具備的功能。存取 Work 的介面是一個標籤選擇器，它將其作為 Chat 的替代方案：顯而易見的問題是，我應該何時使用 Chat，何時使用 Work？ OpenAI's 對此問題的正式回答是：當您需要答案、解釋、腦力激盪或簡短草稿時，請使用 Chat。當您需要 ChatGPT 完成一項具有明確結果的任務時，例如撰寫簡報、簡報、分析、定期更新、工作計畫等，請使用 ChatGPT Work。

primary_item.summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so far. ChatGPT Work is actually two products The more interesting version of ChatGPT Work is the one that runs in the cloud. This can be accessed via chatgpt.com or through the ChatGPT mobile apps. Let's call it Work Cloud . If you install the ChatGPT desktop app - the app that used to be called Codex - you gain access to a thing called ChatGPT Work that can access files and run programs directly on your computer. Let's call that one Work Local . This one feels more like regular Codex re-skinned to be less intimidating to non-software-developers. ( Update : Work Cloud is also available from the ChatGPT desktop app, via a Where should this chat run? dropdown.) For the rest of this article I'm going to talk exclusively about Work Cloud. Work is for paid subscribers only Right now, ChatGPT Work (in both flavors) is available only to $20/month and up subscribers. Free users and $8/month Go users do not have access. sources.summary: Google Cloud AI Research, with Washington University in St. Louis and UNC Chapel Hill, has released EnvHarness, an Apache-2.0 layer that turns a static agent benchmark into one that adapts to the policy training on it. It wraps a frozen environment through the standard reset()/step() interface, so tasks and human-built verifiers stay untouched — and an LLM designer, EnvRigger, writes those wrappers automatically against flaws diagnosed in the agent's own rollouts. Across five benchmarks, mined skills gain up to 9.0 points on held-out tasks with 9.8% fewer execution steps. The post Google AI Introduces EnvHarness: A Programmable Layer That Turns Static Agent Environments Into Adaptive Training Worlds appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Google 雲端人工智慧研究中心與聖路易斯華盛頓大學和北卡羅來納大學教堂山分校合作，發布了 EnvHarness，這是一個 Apache 2.0 層，可以將靜態智能體基準測試轉換為能夠適應其策略訓練的自適應環境。它透過標準的 reset()/step() 介面封裝了一個凍結的環境，因此任務和人工建置的驗證器保持不變——LLM 的設計者 EnvRigger 會針對智能體自身部署中發現的缺陷自動編寫這些封裝器。在五個基準測試中，挖掘出的技能在保留的任務上最多可獲得 9.0 分的提升，同時執行步驟減少了 9.8%。這篇文章《Google AI 推出 EnvHarness：將靜態智能體環境轉化為自適應訓練環境的可程式層》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: AI 早報 2026 08 31 影片版 ：嗶哩嗶哩 ｜ YouTube 概覽 產品應用 ChatGPT 應用近期推送懶載入更新，長對話提速10倍 ↗ 1 Codex 負責人 Tibo 宣佈Codex和ChatGPT Work用量重置 ↗ 2 前瞻與傳聞 報道稱OpenAI購買數萬臺Mac mini與Mac Studio用於Agent訓練 ↗ 3 報道稱字節豆包2.2延期以補強程式設計與Agent能力 ↗ 4 產品應用 ChatGPT 應用近期推送懶載入更新，長對話提速10倍 1 ChatGPT 桌面端近期最佳化了長對話的載入方式，不再一開啟聊天就讀取全部歷史內容，而是先載入最近幾輪，需要時再繼續讀取。工程師 Brent Traut 表示，這讓長對話的載入時間和記憶體佔用都減少了 90% 以上，新對話已經生效，舊對話…

sources.title: Google關閉了Jeff Dean的帳號。 Gemini 3.5 Pro的狀態仍然是「即將上線」。 / Google closed Jeff Dean's account. Gemini 3.5 Pro is still 'soon.'

sources.title_en: Google closed Jeff Dean's account. Gemini 3.5 Pro is still 'soon.'
sources.title_original: Google closed Jeff Dean's account. Gemini 3.5 Pro is still 'soon.'
sources.summary: The June slide said the flagship would ship that month. The July post said partners were testing it. August took the chief scientist, the Gemini co-lead, and the DeepMind CEO’s operating job. The playlist from the old Research all-hands died with the corp login.
sources.summary_zh: 六月的幻燈片顯示旗艦產品將於當月出貨。七月份的貼文稱合作夥伴正在進行測試。八月份，首席科學家、Gemini聯合負責人以及Google DeepMind執行長的營運職位相繼離職。舊研發部門全體員工大會的播放清單也隨著公司登入帳號的登出而消失。
